verdict.rationale: PostHog clearly ships official SDKs. The AI wizard "instruments the PostHog SDKs client-side and server-side" across 26+ documented frameworks and languages, and events can be captured "from any SDK." A hands-on user found integrating the Swift iOS SDK straightforward, and per-endpoint OpenAPI specs let you generate typed clients. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK reference docs or an explicit per-language SDK list in the evidence, plus SDK versioning/stability details beyond the beta 0.x `@posthog/mcp` SDK.
